recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, repetitive pattern of two vertical columns featuring oversized, polished gold Cuban-link chains against a stark white background, overlaid with centered red sans-serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical symmetry between two parallel chain columns
High contrast between reflective gold surfaces and flat white negative space
Translucent red text overlaying the central intersection of the chains
coreInvariants: Polished gold metallic texture with deep brown shadows
Strict vertical alignment of chain links
Centered, condensed sans-serif typography in a muted red tone

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale vertical chains dominate the left and right thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central point where the two chains nearly touch, serving as the base for the text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move vertically along the chain links, then settle on the central red text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Clean white space visible through the center and edges of the chain links.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Red (typography and horizontal divider line)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white and dark metallic shadows; low saturation in the red text to maintain legibility against the busy background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used with varying scales for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, and bold nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean grotesque structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a seamless pattern of two vertical columns of thick, polished gold Cuban-link chains on a pure white background. The lighting should create high-contrast reflections and deep shadows on the metal.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add centered, condensed bold sans-serif text in a muted red color. Include a thin horizontal red line separating the main title from the secondary information.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered and legible against the gold?
Is the red color muted rather than neon?

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic realism in chain links
Verify vertical alignment of the two columns
Ensure the red text is centered and uses a condensed font
Confirm white space is clean and consistent
recipe.reuseFormula: Vertical metallic pattern + centered condensed sans-serif overlay + high-contrast lighting.
